children: BioVie agreed to sell common shares and pre-funded warrants in a registered direct offering and issue common warrants in a concurrent private placement, raising approximately $4.74 million in gross proceeds. The offering closed November 5, 2026, and the company plans to use net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. BioVie also appointed Alliance Global Partners as exclusive placement agent, agreeing to pay a 7% cash fee on gross proceeds plus certain expense reimbursements.
